title: Editor Setup
motto: Your editor is your co-pilot. Configure it once so it stays out of your way and starts pulling its weight.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Your editor is your co-pilot. Configure it once so it stays out of your way and starts pulling its weight.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You'll spend thousands of hours inside your editor writing Python, running notebooks, debugging training loops, and SSH-ing into GPU boxes. A misconfigured editor turns every session into friction: no autocomplete, no type hints, no inline errors, manual formatting, and a clunky terminal workflow.
The right setup takes 20 minutes. Skipping it costs you 20 minutes every day.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Your editor is mission control: LSP for types, integrated terminal for runs, debugger for breakpoints. Cursor/VS Code + Python/TS extensions match the rest of this course.
